description: Answer key for the Phase 2 scanner. Maps each seed app to the rule IDs it MUST trigger. Any rule not listed must NOT fire for that app.
assumptions: NHI-006 is excluded everywhere: sign-in activity cannot be seeded, so all seeds look 'never signed in'. Decide in Phase 3 how 'never' is treated; until then the validator ignores NHI-006.

NHI-007 ('Active client secret in use') fires only on non-expired client secrets; remediation is federation or managed identity. seed-03's secret expires 1 day after seeding, so its expectation depends on the inventory's scanStartUtc: before expiry it triggers NHI-007 only, after expiry NHI-003 only. See the time_dependent block on seed-03.

NHI-008 ('Tenant-wide admin consent to a high-risk delegated permission') fires on an oauth2PermissionGrant with consentType AllPrincipals and a scope in [Mail.Read, Mail.ReadWrite, Mail.Send, Files.ReadWrite.All, Directory.ReadWrite.All, Application.ReadWrite.All, RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory]. Weight Low, control AC-6.

The validator checks seed identities only, identified by the 'nhi-lab-seed' tag in application.tags or servicePrincipal.tags, never by display name (notes are not captured in the inventory, so tags are the only marker). The keys in 'apps' below are display names used purely as labels to look up which expectations apply to a tag-verified seed; a name never decides whether an identity is a seed. The validator must fail if a tagged identity has no key here, or a key here has no tagged identity (this catches renames). Non-seed identities such as Graph Command Line Tools are ignored.

Time-dependent expectations are resolved against the inventory's own scanMetadata.scanStartUtc, never the current clock, so re-validating an old inventory file gives the same answer. The pivot is the credential's endDateTime read from the inventory; a credential is expired when endDateTime <= scanStartUtc. Re-running the seed script skips existing apps, so it does not reset seed-03's secret.
NHI-004 is based on GRANTED application permissions. Requested-but-not-consented (seed-07) and delegated-only (seed-08) must not trigger it.

seed-11's only credential lives on the SERVICE PRINCIPAL (hidden-credential technique); the app registration has none. Credential rules (NHI-002/003/007) must read both application.* and servicePrincipal.* credentials.

Phase 5: seed-02-longsecret is state-dependent (state_dependent block). Its secret is deleted only after GitHub Actions OIDC federation is proven, so the answer key accepts BOTH the before state (secret present: NHI-002 + NHI-007) and the after state (no secret, matching federated credential: no findings). The federated state requires the federated credential to match issuer, subject and audiences exactly; a credential for a different subject does not count.

Phase 4 (Entra Agent ID, seed/New-AgentIdSeed.ps1): the two blueprints carry the nhi-lab-seed tag; Graph documents an agent's tags as the union of its own and its blueprint's, but the live tenant returned tags = [] for the agents (2026-10-19), so the validator counts an untagged agent as a seed when its agentIdentityBlueprintId points at a tagged seed blueprint. Agent ID objects have no notes property.

Phase 4: NHI-Seed-BP-Risky's 180-day secret is created client-side as now+180d and stamped server-side a moment later, so its whole-day lifetime is 179 and NHI-002 must NOT fire (same skew note as TODO.md). NHI-007 must not fire on a blueprint: NHI-009 replaces it.

Phase 4: NHI-Seed-Agent-Risky-1 holds Mail.ReadWrite because Entra refused Directory.ReadWrite.All for an agent identity (lab, 2026-10-16). If the seed is rebuilt and a different permission is granted, check the manifest's blockedByEntra and update this entry.
score_constraint_note: Subjects are answer-key names, resolved to identities by the nhi-lab-seed tag (see assumptions). Each constraint keeps its original sentence in 'text'; 'type' and the other fields are what Test-NhiFindings.ps1 executes.

state_dependent.pivot: client secrets in application.passwordCredentials and servicePrincipal.passwordCredentials, and application.federatedIdentityCredentials, all read from the inventory (never from names)

with_secret.when: at least one client secret with endDateTime > scanStartUtc (also true while a federated credential coexists with the secret)

federated.when: no client secret at all AND at least one federated credential matching expected_federation exactly (case-sensitive; issuer, subject and the whole audiences set)

seed-02-longsecret.purpose: Phase 5 target. A 730-day client secret (NHI-002 + NHI-007) that is replaced by GitHub Actions OIDC federation, after which it must produce no findings. Any other state (no secret and no matching federated credential, or only expired secrets) fails the validator rather than guessing. Inventories from before scanner v0.3.0 have no federatedIdentityCredentials and still resolve to with_secret.

time_dependent.pivot: endDateTime of the single client secret in application.passwordCredentials

seed-03-expiring.purpose: A short-lived secret that flips from NHI-007 (active) to NHI-003 (expired) as the clock passes its end date. Synthetic fixtures (TODO.md) cover both sides and the exact boundary.

seed-07-requested-only.purpose: requested vs granted: must produce no findings

seed-08-mailread-delegated.purpose: tenant-wide delegated Mail.Read consent: triggers NHI-008 (Low) but not NHI-004; must score below seed-04

seed-11-sp-secret.purpose: SP-level (hidden) active secret, 90 days, owned: triggers NHI-007 only; proves the scanner reads SP credentials

NHI-Seed-BP-Clean.purpose: Agent ID negative control: blueprint with a 90-day certificate, owner and enabled sponsor

NHI-Seed-BP-Risky.purpose: blueprint with an active client secret above a Mail.ReadWrite agent: NHI-009 plus the COMBO-U3 uplift (see C6)

NHI-Seed-Agent-Clean-1.purpose: User.Read.All is not a high-risk permission; sponsor and no owner must NOT fire NHI-001

NHI-Seed-Agent-Risky-2.purpose: harmless sibling under the risky blueprint: the blueprint's risk is not pushed down onto it

score_constraints.text: score(seed-09-worstcase) is the maximum across all seeds
score_constraints.subject: seed-09-worstcase

score_constraints.text: score(NHI-Seed-BP-Risky) == 40 (NHI-009 High 25 + COMBO-U3 15): the cross-identity uplift fires
score_constraints.subject: NHI-Seed-BP-Risky

score_constraints.text: score(NHI-Seed-BP-Risky) > score(NHI-Seed-Agent-Risky-1): the shared credential outranks the single privileged agent
